track: round-8 ridge-law refit and criterion characterisation
convention: theta = U_d/s_d = mud/sd (U_d = mud, no factor of 2); ridge = load at which the LOADED median T_fix crosses `level` (canonical 1/2) x the matched NEUTRAL (mud=0) median; every geometry normalised by its own pooled anchor. Traced law: s* ~ Lambda^gamma with gamma = 1/(k+1): k=0<->gamma=1 (pure rate), k=1<->gamma=1/2 (Haigh U_d/s_d const), k=2<->gamma=1/3.
data_substitution_note: ridge_law.parquet and ridge_law_summary.json are NOT inside the round-8 kernel .tgz; the deposited artifact-store copies (artifact ids 136daa15, fdc51a8d) were used. All other inputs are from the bundle.

pooled_anchor.composition: deposited 2,856-run 192x32 Moore neutral pool (ladderN32 200 + tfixexp1 150 + tfixexp2 250 + census 256 + new 2000) extended with the regime grid's 200-run neutral (Kruskal-Wallis across all 6 components p=0.965; grid vs pool MWU p=0.962) -> 3,056 runs

run_level_bootstrap.note: run-level bootstrap resamples ONLY simulation noise; it excludes the residual scatter of the 8 points about the line, which the OLS interval carries. The bootstrap CI on k [1.06,1.28] therefore excludes 1.0 while the OLS 95% CI [0.87,1.53] includes it; the OLS interval is the appropriate error currency for the exponent, the bootstrap quantifies simulation noise.

family_heterogeneity.interpretation: the fixed-Lambda T1 ladders (low Lambda) and the regime grid (high Lambda) have different local slopes (0.418 vs 0.588) under BOTH anchor conventions (legacy 0.419 vs 0.587) -> a family/curvature property, not an artefact of re-anchoring; with n=8 the split is not significant (family p=0.15, curvature p=0.087) though dAIC mildly favours two slopes (-3.6). The single-power-law k=1 selection is a compromise between these two internally-consistent subsets.

anchor_sensitivity.verdict: first-order INSENSITIVE to a COMMON anchor level (d gamma/d ln a = 0.033: a 5.6% common shift moves gamma by 0.0018, k by 0.008, i.e. it slides all points along the fit and changes only the prefactor by ~+6.4%). The observed refit shift (delta gamma -0.016, delta k +0.07) is ~9x larger because the two legacy anchors were mutually INCONSISTENT (T1 anchored 5.8% low, grid 1.2% high): a DIFFERENTIAL anchor shift rotates the line. The exponent is anchor-consistency sensitive, not anchor-level sensitive.

crossing_level_envelope.definition: at each crossing level L, theta* = load at which the loaded/neutral MEDIAN ratio crosses L; canonical L=0.5 (half the neutral median). Pooled 2,856-run anchor (deposited round-7 pool), loglin scheme, run-level bootstrap with a shared anchor draw.

envelope_sd0p01.note: the reviewer-cited 0.23-0.76 envelope corresponds to crossing levels 0.7 (0.228) and 0.3 (0.761) at s_d=0.01; the 0.75/0.25 pair is 0.199/1.209. At level 0.25 the pooled RE constant is dominated by the s_d=0.0025 rung whose median-ratio curve reaches 0.241 only at theta=16 (crossing 14.5, 71% of bootstraps defined) -> the low-level end of the RE envelope is not data-supported; quote the s_d=0.01 rung envelope, or the RE constant excluding the shelf.

crossing_level_envelope.crossing_softness_csv: crossing_softness.csv (theta-decades over which the median-ratio sits within +/-0.05 of the level, per rung)
crossing_level_envelope.reproduction_check: level-0.5 per-sd values match the deposited per_sd (0.6325/0.3582/0.3725/0.5288/0.6215); RE pooled 0.4754 vs deposited 0.4748; levels 0.3-0.7 match the deposited crossing_level_table exactly.

design.geometry: 192x32 Moore, dt=2400, avg=1.16e-5 (p_die=0.02746), sb=0.1, mub=0, sampling=1e4, prof_halfwidth=64, ben_cap=1024

fresh_anchor.note: the fresh 600-run anchor came out 6.3% below the 2,856-run pool - statistically consistent (MWU p=0.068, KW p=0.63) but the same magnitude/sign as the legacy N32 offset. A 600-run anchor at this geometry has ~+/-7% median scatter (T_fix is heavy tailed, mean/median 1.27); pooling to thousands, not a 600-run floor, is what removes ~6% anchor systematics.

design.ladder_seeds: rung j: 13575000 + 200*j + [0..95] (13575000-13576695); all 1,464 seeds unique, inside the track block 13,570,000-13,609,999, disjoint from every deposited seed set (checked against exact seed sets, incl. bd_results and tail_ensemble)

theta_star_0p00125.statement: no half-neutral-median crossing exists within the sampled theta<=1.6 under any anchor or estimator (min median-ratio 0.52-0.55 at theta=1.6); crossing lies at theta>1.6 (extrapolated 2.3-3.5, own-anchor bootstrap [2.0,10.3]); P(theta*(0.00125) > theta*(0.0025)=0.63) = 1.00 under both anchors.

comparison_to_sd0p0025.verdict: left arm CONTINUES RISING: 0.36-0.37 (sd 0.005-0.01) -> 0.63 (sd 0.0025) -> >1.6 (sd 0.00125). Not a flattening, not a turn-over.

headline_verdict: (A) k=1 (Haigh U_d/s_d = const) survives re-anchoring: pooled-anchor free fit gamma=0.464+-0.028 (OLS 95% CI [0.395,0.534]), k=1.15+-0.13 (CI [0.87,1.53]); dAIC vs free: k=1 -0.14 (accepted, F=1.57 p=0.26), k=2 +10.1 (rejected), gamma=0 s*=const +28.5, k=0 pure-rate +30.8 (both decisively rejected). Exponent is first-order insensitive to a common anchor (d gamma/d ln a=0.033) but the two legacy anchors were mutually inconsistent (+5.8%/-1.2%), which rotated the deposited fit by delta k=+0.07. (B) Level envelope at s_d=0.01: 1.21 / 0.37 / 0.20 for levels 0.25/0.5/0.75 (0.76/0.37/0.23 for 0.3/0.5/0.7); RE constant 2.05/0.48/0.17 (the level-0.25 RE is shelf-dominated and not data-supported). (C) New s_d=0.00125 rung: NO crossing within theta<=1.6; left arm continues rising (theta*>1.6, extrapolated ~2.3-3.5), P(exceeds the 0.63 shelf)=1.00.
